items.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Authorizes $25 Billion Share Repurchase Program
items.summary: Lam Research (NasdaqGS:LRCX) approved a new US$25b share repurchase authorization with no stated end date. The buyback authorization is incremental to the company’s existing share repurchase programs. Lam Research also declared its regular quarterly dividend, reinforcing ongoing cash returns to shareholders. This fresh US$25b repurchase plan and dividend decision only captures one side of Lam Research’s current risk reward profile. Our analysis turns up 1 major warning sign for Lam Research...
